title: Sentiment-Driven Stochastic Volatility: An Observable Second Factor from Market Attention
summary: We introduce a two-factor stochastic volatility model in which the mean-reversion speed of a Cox--Ingersoll--Ross variance process is an observable functional of a market attention field rather than a latent factor. The field admits an exact Feynman--Kac representation and generates closed-form volatility forecasts. The model nests the Heston volatility model, provides measurement-stable dynamics under observable data aggregation, and preserves its structure under an equivalent martingale measure.
